privacy.title: Personal Data Processing Notice
privacy.dataProcessed: The application processes data needed to track course activities: first name, surname, JMBAG, email address, group membership, attendance, submitted work, scores and feedback.
privacy.storageAndAccess: Data is stored exclusively on the university's server. Students can see only their own data; lecturers and teaching assistants can see the data of students enrolled in their courses or assigned groups.
privacy.retentionContact: Data controller, retention period and contact details of the university's data protection officer:
